decisions.rationale: Six days in, zero customer replies to three outreaches (512f281c, 829da4e1, 2ccece62) and no tickets; even the held onboarding call (calendar:08d77075) produced no project, invite, or milestone. Passive, non-responsive accounts rarely self-activate in the remaining 8 days.

draft.subject: One first project for Maple Group
draft.body:
Hi Ines,

Thanks again for making time for our onboarding call last week. Since then I haven't wanted to pile on emails, so this is my last nudge for now.

The quickest way to see what Wrenfield is for is one real project: projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, and when you're ready, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a 15-minute call this week help? I'm happy to set up that first project with you live.

Best,
Priya
